name: Competent Automobiles Company Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Competent Automobiles Company Ltd is an Authorized Dealer of Maruti Suzuki India Limited[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
CACL is a part of Delhi based Competent group. It is an authorised Maruti and Nexa dealer in Delhi, Haryana and Himachal Pradesh. Company has 24 showrooms, 8 e-outlets and 15 workshops, and has received approvals to open showrooms in New Delhi and HP.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.67 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
